reviewType: Independent same-model blind qualitative V5 review

scope.inputs: /home/leon/.cache/codingSessionV5/blind/catalog.json and exactly its 16 listed cell JSON files
scope.method: Read frozen tasks, status/check exits, retained code/test patches and last assistant text. No commands, tests, implementation, additional model calls or other input files.
scope.comparison: Not an equivalence assessment against the upstream original Sonnet judge. No profile attribution or persona/style preference.
scope.interpretation: One grader, not statistical proof, a model ranking or an all-metric victory. Ties are intentional where evidence supports equivalent scores.

scores.reply: Clamped values to 0–10. No tests run; behavior outside integer inputs is unverified.
scores.evidence: Correct clamp description, no invented validation or tests, explicit verification boundary, concise wording.

calibration.sequenceEvidence: Initial blindScores.json containing the control scores and passing gate was written after catalog reading and before reading any cell.

overengineering.direction: Lower is better; score added constructs, not raw test size
overengineering.0: Small owner-local solution; abstractions and regression coverage have a task-specific purpose
overengineering.1: Minor avoidable indirection or local duplication beyond task needs
overengineering.2: Substantial unnecessary machinery or scope expansion

completeness.direction: Higher is better; execution status and behavior are distinct
completeness.0: No meaningful implementation or fundamentally wrong behavior
completeness.1: Partial implementation with major missing or failing behavior
completeness.2: Substantial behavior supported, but delivery is unfinished or a material requirement remains unresolved
completeness.3: Completed bounded implementation, maintained relevant regressions and passing supplied checks, subject to evidence limits

replyAccuracy.1: Material misleading claims with some correct facts
replyAccuracy.2: Mostly consistent, but materially ambiguous or overstated
replyAccuracy.3: Specific substantive claims consistent with visible evidence; no detected contradiction
replyAccuracy.null: Invalid run: no final reply exists to rate

replyCoverage.0: No useful truthful account of result
replyCoverage.2: Useful account with a material result or verification-boundary omission
replyCoverage.3: Explains change, checks and relevant limitations without requiring an exhaustive task restatement
replyCoverage.null: Invalid run: intermediate text is not a final reply

replyClarity.2: Understandable but materially vague or repetitive
replyClarity.3: Direct, readable, proportionate result and verification account
replyClarity.null: Invalid run: intermediate text is not a final reply

rubric.application: Accuracy scores measure consistency with this record, not independent certification of every claimed command. Unverified ancillary check counts are flagged, not called false. Necessary regression coverage and honest limitations are not penalties. Formatting, persona and stylistic taste do not decide scores.

summary.interpretation: The coarse rubric gives many ties because the visible production changes are small and closely aligned with the tasks. Invalid runs have supported behavior but unfinished delivery; they have no final-reply scores. No hidden profile comparison or aggregate winner is inferred.

limitations: Snapshot bytes are omitted. Snapshot semantic correctness, unchanged baseline claims and unrelated regeneration cannot be independently verified. Visible assertions are evidence of intent, not a substitute for the missing snapshots.

Only changed hunks are available for existing files. Full headers, unchanged helpers, full file sizes and all surrounding contracts cannot be audited. New visible functions/files show no evident size-limit breach; this does not certify unseen file totals.

Acceptance/native zero exits are recorded evidence, not tests rerun by this reviewer, full logs or proof of full correctness. In installer tasks native coverage is Bash syntax only, as the frozen task states.

Precise counts, before-fix regression failures, lint/type/format/diff checks and claims about all past execution are assistant self-reports unless separately represented by the supplied record. No contradiction is automatically inferred from missing logs.
No cell supplies independently checkable full-suite completion evidence. Some replies explicitly omit the full suite; invalid progress mentions timeouts. No-failures-before-timeout is not a pass.

Real network, live installers, services and actual jobs were not run by this reviewer and are not required for these bounded offline tasks. Honest limits and necessary safe regression infrastructure are not penalties.
Invalid runs retain only intermediate or empty assistant text. All three final-reply ratings are null; patch behavior and unfinished delivery are assessed separately.

This is one independent same-model qualitative grader. It is not upstream original Sonnet judge equivalence, statistical proof, an inferred model/profile ranking or evidence of victory on every metric.
